summary: Classic Buzz flanger: a very short delayed copy swept by an LFO, with rate, depth, feedback, minimum delay in tenths of a millisecond and dry and wet levels. For jet sweeps; Neo Ensemble has a flanger mode.
quirks: Mono out, and about 6 dB louder than its input at unity settings: NeoBuzz Live feeds a mono native effect left + right summed (ReBuzz/NativeMachine/NativeMessage.cs). Profile: +8.8 dB at the defaults.
Feedback at +100 percent diverges (the engine's guard caught it): the safe range is -100 to +98.4 percent.
Wet out defaults to -100 percent (raw 0), an inverted copy; set it to the middle or above for the usual sound.
min. delay counts tenths of a millisecond (0 to 5 ms); Jeskola Chorus's counts milliseconds.
Closed source: names come from its own descriptions and measurements, not from code.

parameters.name: freq
parameters.description: LFO Frequency in hundreths of Hz
parameters.how: Sets the speed of the sweep that moves the delayed copy, from 0 to 40.96 Hz in steps of 0.01 Hz.
parameters.sound: Low values give a slow, seasick swell; high values turn the movement into a fast warble or vibrato.

parameters.name: depth
parameters.how: Sets how far the sweep moves the delay time, from 0 to 100 percent.
parameters.sound: At 0 the copy stands still and only thickens the sound; higher depth adds pitch wobble and a wider swirl.

parameters.name: feedback

safe_range.reason: diverges at its maximum (100.0%: +60.7 dBFS: the engine's guard caught it)

parameters.how: Feeds part of the delayed copy back in, from -100 to +100 percent (64 is none); negative values invert each pass.
parameters.sound: Positive feedback adds resonant ringing and a metallic edge; negative gives a hollow, different colour. Near the ends it rings hard.

parameters.name: min. delay
parameters.description: Minimum delay in tenths of ms
parameters.how: Sets the shortest delay the sweep reaches, from 0 to 5 ms in steps of 0.1 ms.
parameters.sound: Very short delays give a tight jet-like comb; larger ones loosen it toward a chorus.

parameters.name: dry out
parameters.how: Sets the level of the untouched signal, from -100 to +100 percent; a negative value flips its polarity.
parameters.sound: Lower it to hear more of the effect on its own; the middle step removes the dry sound completely.

parameters.name: wet out
parameters.how: Sets the level of the delayed copy, from -100 to +100 percent; a negative value flips its polarity.
parameters.sound: More wet means a stronger effect; flipping it against the dry sound changes the comb pattern from bright to hollow.
